mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as atCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as atCAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Pc_Award_Ticket mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.At_C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.At_Id where mn.Pay_Id = #{payId}

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as atCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as atCAbbName, pay.Pay_Code as payCode, pay.Pay_Type as payType, pay.Pay_Type_Detailed as payTypeDetailed, pay.Pay_Create_Time as payCreateTime, pay.Pay_State as payState, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Pc_Award_Ticket mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.At_C_Id left join Con_Pay pay on pay.Pay_Id = mn.Pay_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.At_Id where mn.At_Id = #{atId}
